errors.message: type names must start with an uppercase letter

name: unbound
source: module M { type T = { x: a | r } }

errors.message:
the type variables a, r are unbound.
E.g., in

   type T = List[a]

type variable 'a' is unbound. To fix it, write

   type T[a] = List[a]
Use 'int -> str' instead of 'Map[int, str]' for map types

name: duplicate
source: module M { val r = { a: 1, a: 2 } }

errors.message: Field a cannot be defined more than once

name: duplicates
source: module M { val r = { a: 1, b: 2, b: 3, a: 4, b: 5 } }

errors.message: Fields b, a cannot be defined more than once
